title: GL Building as Lattice Functions
body_html:
GL Building as Lattice Functions

The extended building \(B(\operatorname{GL}(V))\) is identified with the set of lattice functions on \(V\), equivalently with splittable \(D\)-norms, as a \(\operatorname{GL}(V)\)-set. This identification is unique up to translation.

If \(x\in B(\operatorname{GL}(V))\) corresponds to \(L\), then the operator-shift filtrations attached to \(L\) agree with the Moy-Prasad filtrations at \(x\).
proof_html: The source cites the standard Bruhat-Tits and Moy-Prasad identification. On an apartment, a splittable norm is determined by a splitting basis, and the Moy-Prasad lattice conditions are exactly the operator-shift conditions defining the lattice-function filtration.
